summary: You can summon deep force when you decide to. The power for total commitment and real transformation is available, switched on by choice. It waits for you to call it up.
body: You can summon deep force when you decide to. The power for total commitment and real transformation is available, switched on by choice. It waits for you to call it up. Left idle, your drive stays ordinary. But when you reach for it, you can throw your whole self at something and remake it, and yourself in the process. The opening pays out when you take it. Call up the force on purpose and you do what half-measures never could.
gift: At your best: capable of total commitment and deep transformation on demand.
shadow: The trap: leaving the deep force idle and running on ordinary drive.
integration: Let drive and anger and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
do: Call up the full force on purpose
Throw your whole self at what matters
Use the power to transform, not dominate
dont: Wait for a fight to summon it
